responsibility: Implements the gm2 front end’s basic `WORD` list container as a chained sequence of fixed-size array blocks. It owns storage allocation, append, nth-element lookup, counting, duplicate suppression, element removal, whole-list iteration, and cloning; many higher-level compiler utilities such as queues and dependency lists build directly on this lightweight segmented list representation.
same_name_distinction: This .mod file is the implementation of the Lists abstraction: it defines List as linked records containing small fixed-size element arrays and supplies the actual append, search, remove, count, and clone algorithms. Unlike Lists.def, it contains the concrete segmented-list representation and memory management.
